verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager, build system and OS configuration tool, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes and invokes tools from MCP servers is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Nix ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
